_comment: Test fixture only, never published: the built-in edition shape (public/data/editions/<book>-<edition>.json) with figures. A figure is a paragraph whose whole text is U+FFFC followed by its id; its picture, caption and size hints are in the chapter's figures list. Invented text; the image paths do not exist.

chapters.title: One
paragraphs: The lamp stood on the sill where it had always stood.
Nobody remembered who had first lit it.

figures.caption: A lamp of the old kind, drawn for this test.

chapters.title: Two
paragraphs: The harbour had forty lamps, and each had a keeper.
The keepers met once a year to compare their ledgers.
